scheme_name: Financial Assistance under Odisha Working Journalist Welfare Scheme
other_conditions: Journalist must be working in Odisha
Journalist must be employed by a media house registered with the Information & Public Relations Department of Odisha
Applicant must be the legal heir of the working journalist in case of death or permanent incapacitation
benefits_summary: Ex‑gratia of ₹4,00,000 for death of a working journalist and ₹2,00,000 for permanent incapacitation
